contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP CAES NERVAE T]RAIANO AVG GER DAC P M TR [P COS V P P] ; R/ SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI (retrograde)

A copper-alloy Roman sestertius of Trajan (AD 98-117), contemporary copy, dating to the period AD 98-117 (Reece period 5). SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI (retrograde) reverse type depicting a modius with corn ears, S C in the field. Obverse inscription: [IMP CAES NERVAE T]RAIANO AVG GER DAC P M TR [P COS V P P]. Obverse description: laureate bust right, slight drapery on left shoulder. Reverse inscription: SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI (retrograde). Reverse description: A modius with corn ears. Diameter: 31.90 mm; Thickness: 4.14 mm; Weight: 17.73g. Discussion (see WMID-2F41FB ). Perhaps an imitative sestertius of Trajan belonging to a group of die-linked coins published by B.
